file_roles.evidence: 'private synchronized void initReaderCache' becomes 'private static synchronized void initReaderCache'. The report states 'readerCache is static' and that access to it 'shouldn't be protected by lock on non-static MicrobatchSource.this', so the lock was guarding the wrong monitor.

rationale: The defect and the place it would surface are the same method: a static field guarded by an instance monitor, so two instances could race into the 'if (readerCache == null)' block. The report is a static-analysis style finding with no runtime failure, so there is no log line to locate. One keyword is added and nothing else changes, which makes the attribution unambiguous.
notes: The defect is a locking error, but it lives at a single site rather than spanning two, so the relation is same-location rather than concurrency.
